finding.headline: "The Church-Cry-Room Anxiety"
finding.problem: "I love my church but I'm a bundle of nerves the whole service waiting for her to cry. Last time I wanted to disappear. Am I a bad Christian mother?"
finding.person: Devout Nigerian/Black Christian mum terrified her baby will cry during service and the priest or congregation will judge (even eject) her — a real, documented pattern (BBC NI Mass ejection; Catholic All Year priest confrontation; Sydney Anglicans "cry-room makes me feel isolated").
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Bring the Baby to the Altar: Serving God Without the Cry-Room Shame."". Verdict: PASSES (strongest emotional hook).
